title: Privacy Based Swap
tagline: A 1Inch Fusion+ swap between ETH + LTC with privacy enhancing for the resolver
description: A 1Inch Fusion+ swap between Ethereum network and Litecoin network with privacy enhancing for the resolver. Resolvers are able to fill orders without adversaries knowing their token balance. Trustless cross-chain swaps between Ethereum and Litecoin users without intermediaries. 1inch Fusion integration to get the best prices with MEV protection. HTLC smart contracts Secure atomic swaps using Hash Time-Locked Contracts. Auto-relayer Service to automated order matching and settlement. MWEB and Railgun features to hide balance of participants.
how_its_made: The project is a swap between LTC network and the Ethereum network. The use of 1Inch Fusion+ is used for order matching and resolver solving. Resolvers are entities that want to make a profit by filling orders for users. As with most profit-seeking activities, other competitors are looking to make the same profit. Tactics include identifying the balance an adversary can conduct, sandwich attacks, front-running, or liquidity-draining attacks by crafting malicious orders. This project adds MWEB to LTC and railgun to ETH to hide the balance of the users.
